description: This file defines a report class for production planning in an ERP system, including data retrieval, processing, and column setup for manufacturing and order management.

classes.name: ProductionPlanReport
classes.description: Main class for generating production planning report, handling data collection, processing, and output formatting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that creates an instance of ProductionPlanReport and executes the report generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing report with filters and data structures.

methods.name: execute_report
methods.description: Main method orchestrating data retrieval, processing, and returning report columns and data.

methods.name: get_open_orders
methods.description: Fetches open work orders, sales orders, or material requests based on filters.

methods.name: prepare_other_conditions
methods.description: Prepares additional SQL filter conditions based on filters and document type.

methods.name: get_raw_materials
methods.description: Retrieves raw materials associated with orders, including BOM and work order items.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Fetches default warehouse details for items involved in the orders.

methods.name: get_bin_details
methods.description: Retrieves current stock quantities in bins for items and warehouses.

methods.name: get_purchase_details
methods.description: Fetches upcoming purchase order arrival details for raw materials.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares and consolidates data for report display, including available quantities.

methods.name: update_raw_materials
methods.description: Updates raw material quantities and assigns warehouses based on filters.

methods.name: pick_materials_from_warehouses
methods.description: Allocates raw materials from warehouses, updating remaining quantities.

methods.name: get_args
methods.description: Creates a template dictionary for report rows.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on filters.
